info.title: RAASOA Knowledge Actions
info.description: Trusted retrieval and ingestion for enterprise knowledge. Authenticate with a Bearer API key.

post.summary: Ingest a document into the knowledge base
post.description: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, text, …). It is parsed, chunked, embedded, quality-checked and indexed for retrieval. Returns the quality score and any quality findings.

Search trusted enterprise knowledge and return ranked, source-attributed passages with a confidence score. Use this to answer any question that depends on the organization's documents, policies, or records. Supports metadata pre-filtering (e.g. only approved documents) and per-source filtering.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Compile a specific topic. Omit to compile all topics.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: keep_a, keep_b, keep_both, reject_both, dismiss. When keep_both: use context_a/context_b to explain WHY both are valid.

context_a.title: Context A
context_a.description: When keep_both: context for Doc A (e.g. 'applies to Marketing dept')

context_b.title: Context B
context_b.description: When keep_both: context for Doc B (e.g. 'applies to Engineering dept')

chunk_id.title: Chunk Id
chunk_id.description: ID of the chunk being rated

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Outcome of using this result: success/failure/partial

outcome_context.title: Outcome Context
outcome_context.description: What happened when the agent used this result

FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest
FeedbackRequest.description: Feedback on a retrieval result — makes future searches smarter.

IndexHit.title: IndexHit
IndexHit.description: Direct answer from the knowledge index (no embedding needed).

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Permission scopes: all, read, write, admin

KeyCreated.title: KeyCreated
KeyCreated.description: Only returned on creation — contains the full key.

PaginatedDocuments.title: PaginatedDocuments
PaginatedDocuments.description: Cursor-based paginated response for document listings.

source_type.title: Source Type
source_type.description: Type: notion, sharepoint, jira, confluence, webhook, custom

sync_interval_minutes.title: Sync Interval Minutes
sync_interval_minutes.description: Auto-sync interval in minutes. None = manual only.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query to filter what gets synced

source_object_id.title: Source Object Id
source_object_id.description: Unique identifier in the source system

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate processing on retries.

bearerAuth.description: RAASOA API key as a Bearer token.
